note: City-of-Pahokee municipal campground on the water side of the Herbert Hoover Dike on Lake Okeechobee (former Lake Okeechobee KOA, now city-operated). About 60 sites have full hookups; level hard-packed limestone pads. Lakeside pool for registered campers. --Claude
